sections.text: You're listening to the Skeptics' Guide to the Universe, your escape to reality.
sections.title: Introduction

sections.text: March 29: Happy birthday to Sanctorius Sanctorius, who experimented on Galileo and weighed his own poop.http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanctorius
sections.title: This Day in Skepticism

sections.text:
Item #1: Scientists report that they have been able to create a quantum entanglement between two particles in 103 dimensions, breaking the previous record of 11 dimensions.
Item #2: Researchers have built logic circuits out of slime molds, opening the door to slime-based computing.
Item #3: A new study finds that the amount of time spent playing online games correlates with increasing non-virtual social isolation.
sections.title: Science or Fiction

sections.text: 'A thing is not proved just because no one has ever questioned it. What has never been gone into impartially has never been properly gone into. Hence skepticism is the first step toward truth. It must be applied generally, because it is the touchstone.' Denis Diderot
